summary: The bounded change adds meaningful declarations and controls, but does not satisfy the accounting foundation. Actual consumer reads escape reconciliation, historical operands remain unchecked, scope accounting is incomplete, valid optional branches are rejected, and computed-output tests survive deletion of the implementation.

blocking_findings.description: Observed accounting does not observe the existing temporal or warrant consumers. It executes the same Expansion traversal against an import-time copy of the declarations, then separately calls the real preparer and retains only its diagnostics. In isolated direct and SQLite-reader probes, bypassing the temporal consumer's Evidence.coverage boundary read with a literal 'interval' returned diagnostics=(), successful support, and an unchanged observed ledger. The new missing/extra-read controls mutate role.Access, so they do not detect this disconnect.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Reconcile independently expanded obligations against actual temporal/warrant boundary consumption and dependency resolution. Add direct and retained controls that omit, substitute and duplicate reads in those actual consumers while preserving otherwise valid values.

blocking_findings.description: History expansion resolves an exact row but discards the returned record without expanding its required operands. An E5 hypothesis audit therefore checks the current confidence and the predecessor's identity, but never the predecessor confidence needed by the upward-revision prerequisite. Direct and SQLite-reader probes returned empty diagnostics and successful full role-profile support when predecessor confidence was missing, null or a string. No predecessor field appeared in expected obligations. The same structural omission applies to original PilotClip operands. This concerns prerequisite access, not deferred history-head selection or final predicates.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Declare and expand the required historical-target operands with exact source and association identities. Add isolated valid, missing, null, malformed and substituted historical-operand controls on direct and retained paths, without implementing deferred history semantics.

blocking_findings.description: Checked applicability does not preserve existing valid optional branches. There is no derivative activation rule based on PilotSubmission.frame_indices, so the generic fallback treats an explicitly null derivative as unavailable even when checked frame_indices is empty. On both isolated adapters, the unchanged temporal preparer accepted this valid no-attachment submission with no diagnostics, while the new audit emitted UNKNOWN/null required field for derivative and denied support. The new preserved-root controls exercise only the attachment-present fixture.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Implement checked activation/inactivity for the existing optional branches, including derivative absence justified by checked empty frame_indices. Carry the existing valid inactive-branch controls through the new audit and add isolated negatives and deletion witnesses.

blocking_findings.description: Scope membership checks only a subset of required links for roots spanning media and intent. EvidenceArm and InstrumentRun are classified solely through evidence.media; their plan.competing_set.intent is never compared with the checked intent. In direct and SQLite-reader probes, an EvidenceArm whose evidence matched the selected media but whose pinned plan belonged to another intent returned active membership with only a media justification. Missing or damaged plan-scope evidence likewise cannot affect this membership decision.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Declare and check every applicable scope dimension through exact dependencies before classifying these roots as active or excluded. Add matching-scope, different-intent-revision, missing-link and malformed-link controls with literal membership diagnostics on both paths.

blocking_findings.description: Scoped preparation discards the accounting foundation it computes. For each active root it preserves only audit diagnostics, dropping expected, observed and checked_inactive. Its returned Receipt consequently always has empty accounting ledgers and no declaration-level inactive obligations; applicability records only rule/root membership. Independent probes confirmed ACTIVE rules with expected=(), observed=() and checked_inactive=(). The unconditional semantic UNKNOWN correctly prevents completion, but does not satisfy the required auditable prerequisite receipt.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Retain each active root's association-preserving expected/observed obligations and checked-inactive evidence in the scoped receipt. Test exact accounting contents for active and mixed active/inactive scopes while preserving incomplete semantic status.

blocking_findings.description: Computed-output coverage is not deletion-sensitive. The tests require valid operands and some support, but do not assert that Evidence.digest or TestPlan.authored was computed, passed through its output boundary, or discharged a computed obligation. I removed the entire computed loop in an in-memory source mutation: all 83 parameterized computed operand/nested controls still passed for each isolated adapter. Both ledgers silently lose the same obligation because they share this implementation. The existing inventory equality tests cannot detect that missing execution.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Add independently specified computed-output expectations and isolated omission, substitution and output-boundary failure controls. Ensure deletion of each computed obligation or its boundary causes the ordinary acceptance test to fail on direct and retained paths.
